chapter: Bird, the band's breakup and Luis Russell
title: Leaving the band after a knife fight with Bob Merrill
summary: In Boston, Merrill came at Ramey over torn music and Ramey cut him, so he quit and took packing-house work.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: What, what -- now wait. I don't follow this quite. McShann went in the army --
Oh, yeah. But you were there when he went in the army?
I came back to the band then. I stayed --
Oh, I see. You left and went back.
Yeah, I left the band and went to Kansas City and got a job working first in a packing house and then a job working in a railroad station.

Well, first of all, I'd had a fight with a guy in the band, and I cut him badly, you know, and ashamed of myself and ashamed of the fact that I had become -- like, you know, well, I was supposed to have been the star of the band, you know. Whenever they had shows or something, it was Jay and I would go, you know. I was the feature, you know, and that sort of thing.
Come to find out that I had a whole lots of silent enemies. I had a fight with the guy, Bob Merrill, and --
What did you fight about then?

He came after me. What had happened, we were in Boston in the Tick Tock Club, and now, we were working under the supervision of Don Redman. So we played a tune -- it was kind of difficult. And -- for a first trumpet player, you know -- and so I was in charge of the band and the music and what's his name was just -- Don Redman was just fronting, you know.

So Bob is supposed to have torn up a piece of music, you know. So right away Gus comes and tells me. And I look up. I'm in a dressing room, you know, and I look up, and then Bob come in and says, 'Well, what are you going to do about it,'

so and so, and he had a picture, about to hit me, you know, and I cut him, and somehow I stopped that picture and got my knife. From that day on I never carried a knife, you know, because I don't even know -- I don't know anything else about it, you know, just that quick, you know.
And then I was so ashamed and disgusted with myself for having been led into something like that, that I just quit the band.
